question: Does a committed UsdPreviewSurface fixture for shading normals, tangents and normal maps extract through Hydra, authored and computed mesh normals included, to its independent C++ mirror and render, headless and through Hydra, in agreement with committed Reference PT images; and which normal behaviours need a fix?

procedure.fixture: python scripts/material_fixtures.py write; usdchecker validation/materials/material-normals-v1.usda (fails only on the Auto, Unscaled and DirectX lookups, which depart from the normal-map encoding on purpose)
procedure.reference: lotus-headless --write-material-reference validation/reference: every fixture in a cleared GPU scene, BSDF sampling, reference integrator, 64 batches of 64 samples then 4096 samples from sample index 0; material-normals-v1 at 160x160
procedure.headless_check: the lotus-headless post-build report in build/cy2026-windows-x86_64-py313-core (renderer.material.fixtures), then ctest -R 'lotus-validation-assets|lotus-renderer-evidence|lotus-renderer-install-tree|lotus-test-tiers'
procedure.hydra: ost build --profile lookdev --intent hydra (build/cy2026-windows-x86_64-py313-lookdev--hydra), then ctest -R material-fixtures
procedure.scripts: python -m unittest test_material_fixtures; python scripts/material_fixtures.py check; python scripts/check_docs.py

extraction.computed_normals: Computed, LeftHanded, Malformed and SphereComputed equal the mirror's float reimplementation of Hd_SmoothNormals bit for bit
extraction.left_handed_quads: HdMeshUtil triangulates a left-handed quad (v0, v1, v2, v3) as (v2, v1, v0), (v2, v0, v3) and a left-handed triangle as (v0, v2, v1)
warnings: Lotus ignores the normals of /MaterialNormals/Objects/Malformed: a vertex or varying primvar needs one value per point

byte_identical: headless wavefront-mis and reference-mis images at 16 and 256 spp
Hydra and the backend's image of the mirror, NEE/MIS and BSDF, 256 spp

negative_control.change: the Mapped material's normal lookup with green scale -2 and bias 1 (five cards)

audit.authored_interpolations: as documented; vertex, indexed face-varying and uniform normals reach every corner
audit.computed_normals: as documented; Storm's coarse smooth normals for catmullClark without usable normals
audit.left_handed: as documented; same normals as the right-handed sphere
audit.malformed_normals: as documented; warns and falls back to computed normals
audit.inward_normals: as documented; turned to the geometric side
audit.normal_map_encoding: as documented; no implicit decoding, auto 8-bit RGB is sRGB, an authored green flip reads a DirectX map
audit.constant_tangent_normal: documented now: through Hydra a material without lookups names no texture-coordinate set, so a constant normal takes the normal-only frame
audit.tangent_frames: as documented; mirrored, rotated, mirrored-transform and stretched mappings render the dome lit from the same side (visual; the arithmetic is renderer.path.normal_maps' oracle check)
audit.curved_surfaces: as documented; per-hit triangle frames on longitude-latitude spheres

not_run: viewport, usdview and the installed Hydra host with the fixture
Hydra CTests other than the two material-fixture CTests
